objective: Certify the minimum of charged ordinary tree proof work for these two opposed evaluators, arbitrary mixed affine queries and strategically placed full one-side affine checks. Include the tree interpretation of a named deduction proved afresh.
status: Proved: For the fixed reports u=p1 and v=p2 XOR p3 the cheapest unshared affine proof tree costs exactly 23 units, seven affine questions and eight checks of each evaluator. Arbitrary timing and order of local checks cannot improve it, and fresh once-used scalar facts may be inlined.
title: Find the least charged work of a five-product tree
